market.summary: Indian shares ended a three-day winning run: the Nifty fell 0.6% to 25,144 and the Sensex 0.4%, with 38 of the Nifty 50 lower and every sector except FMCG in the red. October inflation at 6.09% (above the RBI's 6% ceiling), Brent near $96 after attacks on Saudi energy sites and Trump's Iran remarks, and a weaker rupee (94.24) did the damage. Foreign investors are still buying (ninth straight day) and the week still closed up about 0.5%, so this is a pause rather than a turn. All six open trades held their stops; four closed up on the day.

points.text: Nifty 50 closed at 25,144.30 (-0.61%), Sensex 81,592.45 (-0.39%); midcap and smallcap indices fell about 0.25%; India VIX dropped 6.5% to 15.55. Third straight weekly gain (Nifty +0.5%).
Realty (-1.4%), auto (-1.1%), metals (-1.0%), banks (-0.8%) and IT (-0.7%) led the fall; FMCG was the only sector up. NSE breadth 1,446 up vs 2,179 down.
October CPI 6.09% vs 5.54% in September, the first breach of the RBI's 6% upper band in about two years; Brent around $95.7 (high $96.8).
Foreign investors bought a provisional Rs 7,831 Cr on 12 Nov (ninth buying day in a row) while domestic funds sold Rs 6,331 Cr; the rupee slipped 21 paise to 94.24 per dollar.

market.watch: Monday: whether the Nifty holds 25,050 (Friday's low) and whether oil stays near $96; high inflation reduces the chance of a rate cut.

GROWW.summary: No new company news or exchange filing today. Groww closed at Rs 224.95 (+1.5%) despite a weak market and financial stocks down 0.7%, which puts the trade right at +2R (Rs 224.90). It has beaten the Nifty Financial Services index by 5 points over the month. The 6 Nov block deal is digested; nothing today changes the trade.

points.text: Close Rs 224.95 vs Rs 221.66 on 12 Nov; +2R is Rs 224.90; 10 EMA Rs 215.38, 20 EMA Rs 207.65.

Q2 FY27: profit Rs 725 Cr (+54%), revenue Rs 1,541 Cr (+44%); Jefferies kept Buy with a Rs 240 target.

GROWW.watch: Sell half on a close below the 10 EMA (Rs 215.38), the rest below Rs 207.65 (20 EMA); Rs 240 is the Jefferies target.

SEJALLTD.watch: A close below cost (Rs 884.13) exits everything under your rule; half goes on a close below the 10 EMA (Rs 885.13).
